title: Holds can fall
changes: Every clan Hold now has a barracks where its soldiers come out, plus supply stores, weapon racks, towers and gates. The bigger the Hold, the more of them it has.
Wreck the barracks and no new soldiers come out. Each thing you wreck earns your clan valor and you renown. Wrecked works are rebuilt after 15 minutes.
Wreck everything and the Hold falls: its walls come down, its soldiers are gone and its land gives its old clan nothing.
Any hero sworn to a clan can claim a fallen Hold by raising their banner at its middle. The land becomes their clan's, a new outpost rises and its barracks sends out soldiers again.
